title: Boston Gas Company has submitted for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365 Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with The Gillette Company.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Transportation Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms under the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC99-39)
